newsitem.title: USA: Quigley says exceeds sales targets.
newsitem.headline: Quigley says exceeds sales targets.

text.p: Quigley Corp, a maker of cold relief lozenges, said on Friday that it had exceeded its sales targets and plans to list its stock on Nasdaq's SmallCap market.

The company, maker of "COLD EEZE" lozenges, said that net sales for the two months ending February 28 were $14 million, ahead of previous estimated sales projections. For the three months ended December 31, Quigley said its sales were $4.1 million.
It said that based on its current financial position and shareholder's equity, it intends to immediately file an application for listing on Nasdaq.
The company's stock is currently traded on the Over-the-Counter Bulletin Board.
